column2: The angry fan hurled a bottle onto the field, and the game stopped.
column3: 憤怒的球迷把一個瓶子猛力扔進場內，比賽因此暫停。
column4: hurl a stone (猛力投擲石頭)
column5: hurl 像「喝兒」：大喝一聲，用力把東西丟出去

column2: The city plans to impose a tax on plastic bags next year.
column3: 市政府計畫明年對塑膠袋課稅。
column5: im 在上面 + pose 放：把負擔放到別人身上

column2: His rude remarks incensed the whole audience, and many people left.
column3: 他無禮的言論激怒了全體觀眾，許多人當場離席。
column5: incense 像「因 sense」：被刺到敏感神經，火氣就上來了

column2: The librarian spent a week indexing the old photo collection by year.
column3: 圖書館員花了一個星期，依年份替舊照片收藏編製索引。
column4: index a collection (替收藏編索引)
column5: index 像「印得克斯」：把重點一條條印出來方便找

column2: The school instituted a new rule that phones must stay in bags.
column3: 學校制定了新規定，手機必須放在書包裡。
column4: institute a new rule (設立新規定)
column5: in 在裡面 + stitute 站立：把制度立在那裡，就是創立

column2: You should insure your phone in case it breaks or gets stolen.
column3: 你應該替手機投保，以防它壞掉或被偷。
column4: insure a house against fire (為房子投保火險)
column5: insure 和 ensure 意思接近；有保險公司才是 insure

column2: The post office will issue a special stamp for the festival.
column3: 郵局將為這個節慶發行一款特別郵票。
column5: issue 像「一書」：一本書一本書地發行出去

column2: He jacked up the car to change the flat tire.
column3: 他把車子用千斤頂頂起來，好更換爆掉的輪胎。
column4: jack up a car (用千斤頂撐起車)
column5: jack 是千斤頂；「加一下」就把車子抬高

column2: Tourists were fined for jaywalking across the busy street.
column3: 遊客因為在繁忙街道亂穿馬路而被罰款。
column4: jaywalk across a street (亂穿馬路)
column5: jay 是松鴉鳥，亂飛亂走；jay + walk 就是亂走路

column2: The crowd jeered when the singer forgot the words to the song.
column3: 歌手忘詞時，群眾發出了嘲笑聲。
column4: jeer at a player (嘲笑球員)
column5: jeer 像「基爾」：大家喊「基爾！」笑對方出糗

column2: Coins jingled in his pocket as he ran down the stairs.
column3: 他跑下樓時，口袋裡的硬幣叮噹作響。
column5: jingle 的聲音就是叮鈴噹啷，像鈴鐺

column2: The cook jugged the hare slowly in a deep clay pot for dinner.
column3: 廚師為晚餐把野兔放在深陶罐裡慢慢燉煮。
column5: jug 本是水罐；把肉放進罐子裡煮，就是 jug

column2: Dry twigs helped us kindle a small fire in the camp.
column3: 乾樹枝幫助我們在營地點起一堆小火。
column5: kindle 像「肯都」：肯都肯，一點火就燃起來

column2: Layer the lasagna with cheese, sauce, and noodles before baking.
column3: 烘烤前，把起司、醬料和麵皮層層疊起做成千層麵。
column4: layer the sauce and cheese (把醬料和起司層層疊上)
column5: layer 是層；動詞就是一層一層堆疊

column2: Several small countries leagued together to protect their trade.
column3: 幾個小國聯合起來，保護他們的貿易。
column5: league 像「栗格」：很多人結盟，像聯盟球隊

column2: Pain medicine can lessen the discomfort after a dental operation.
column3: 止痛藥可以減輕牙科手術後的不適。
column5: less 少 + en 使：讓痛變少一點

column2: The player limped off the field after twisting his ankle.
column3: 球員扭到腳踝後一跛一跛地走下球場。
column4: limp off the field (跛行離場)
column5: limp 像「林普」：林先生走路一拐一拐

column2: The smell of fresh bread lingered in the kitchen all morning.
column3: 新鮮麵包的香味整個早上都留在廚房裡。
column4: linger in the air (停留在空氣中)
column5: linger 像「領哥兒」：領哥捨不得走，一直逗留

column2: The hotel lodged us in a quiet room facing the lake.
column3: 旅館安排我們住進面向湖景的安靜房間。
column5: lodge 像「落戟」：落腳停下來住宿，也是把意見落下來申訴

column2: Workers lumbered in the northern forest for most of the winter.
column3: 工人們在冬天的大部分時間都在北方森林裡伐木。
column4: lumber in the forest (在森林伐木)
column5: lumber 也是木材；到森林裡取木材，就是伐木

column2: Teachers often lump all the beginners into one class.
column3: 老師常常把所有初學者歸併到同一班。
column5: lump 是一塊；把東西弄成一塊一塊，就是歸併

column2: A microscope can magnify a tiny insect to many times its size.
column3: 顯微鏡可以把微小的昆蟲放大到好幾倍大。
column5: magni 大 + fy 使：讓它變大

column2: Visitors marveled at the old temple's carved wooden doors.
column3: 遊客對古老廟宇上雕刻精美的木門讚嘆不已。
column4: marvel at the view (對景色讚嘆)
column5: marvel 像「馬佛」：看到馬跑得這麼快，佛都驚訝

column2: Mash the boiled potatoes with a fork until they are smooth.
column3: 用叉子把煮熟的馬鈴薯壓成糊狀，直到變得細滑。
column5: mash 像「媽屎」：媽用叉子把東西壓爛

column2: The nurse massaged my sore shoulders after the long ride.
column3: 長途騎車之後，護理師替我痠痛的肩膀按摩。
column4: massage a sore back (按摩痠痛的背)
column5: massage 像「媽薩吉」：媽媽幫你揉一揉，就按摩

column2: A neighbor mediated the dispute between the two families.
column3: 一位鄰居居中調停了兩個家庭之間的糾紛。
column5: medi 中間：站在兩人中間，把爭吵調停

column2: The bully menaced the younger boy with a clenched fist.
column3: 霸凌者握緊拳頭威嚇那個比較小的男孩。
column5: menace 像「美奈思」：美奈思，名字好聽卻來嚇人，記得威脅

column2: At the party, she mingled with guests she had never met.
column3: 派對上，她和素未謀面的賓客們互相交談往來。
column5: mingle 像「悶果」：悶在一起的果汁混合在一起

column2: The injured hiker moaned softly while waiting for help.
column3: 受傷的登山客一邊等待救援，一邊輕聲呻吟。
column5: moan 像「摸恩」：痛痛地摸著傷口發出聲音

column2: The government wants to modernize the old train system.
column3: 政府想要使老舊的火車系統現代化。
column4: modernize the railway (使鐵路現代化)
column5: modern 現代 + ize 使變成：讓它變現代

column2: You may modify the recipe by adding less sugar.
column3: 你可以少放些糖來修改食譜。
column5: mod 模式 + ify 使：把模式改一改

column2: Villagers mounded earth against the river bank to stop the flood.
column3: 村民在河岸邊堆起土堆以阻擋洪水。
column5: mound 像「帽的」：土堆得高高像一頂帽子

column2: The rider mounted the horse and rode slowly out of the gate.
column3: 騎士跨上馬背，緩緩騎出大門。
column5: mount 是山；動詞就是爬上去

column2: The whole school mourned the loss of their beloved principal.
column3: 全校師生為失去敬愛的校長而哀悼。
column5: mourn 像「摸恩」：低著頭，靜靜表達難過

column2: He mumbled his answer so quietly that nobody could hear it.
column3: 他含糊地說出答案，聲音小到沒人聽得見。
column5: mumble 像「慢伯」：慢慢低聲說，嘴巴含著東西

column2: She muttered something about the weather and went back inside.
column3: 她小聲嘀咕了幾句天氣的事，就走回屋裡。
column4: mutter under your breath (低聲嘀咕)
column5: mutter 像「馬特」：馬在旁邊低低地嘀咕

column2: Mom keeps nagging me to clean my room before dinner.
column3: 媽媽不斷唸我，要我在晚餐前整理房間。
column4: nag someone to hurry (一直催某人快一點)
column5: nag 像「那個」：「那個那個」一直唸不停

column2: Sailors navigated the narrow river using an old paper map.
column3: 水手們憑著一張舊紙地圖在狹窄的河道上航行。
column5: navi 船 + gate：找到出口，船才能前進

column2: The rabbit nibbled the lettuce leaf one tiny bite at a time.
column3: 兔子一小口一小口地啃著那片萵苣葉。
column4: nibble on a snack (小口啃零食)
column5: nibble 像「你不」：你不要一口吃完，小口小口慢慢啃

column2: The factory nickels small metal parts to keep them from rusting.
column3: 工廠在小金屬零件上鍍鎳，防止生鏽。
column4: nickel metal parts (替金屬零件鍍鎳)
column5: nickel 是鎳；動詞就是在表面薄薄鍍一層鎳
